findings.title: Tail probabilities preserve representable nonzero values
findings.formula_or_invariant: Coefficient p=2*P(T_df>=abs(t)) and model p=P(F>=f) must use stable right-tail evaluation and satisfy reject_zero_mismatch.
reproduction_steps: Run the frozen Python cases and guarded oracle; inspect p_values and f_p_value zero_mismatch fields.
findings.disposition: CLOSED. Production and the independent oracle use survival functions; both frozen zero-mismatch safety checks pass.

findings.title: Scaled rank-revealing least squares closes scale and near-collinearity failures
findings.formula_or_invariant: Nonzero column rescaling preserves rank and fitted values after reciprocal coefficient mapping; full-rank ill-conditioned designs require a rank-revealing solve.
affected_cases: full-rank scaled or near-collinear public inputs

evidence.rank_deficient_error: ValueError: OLS design is rank deficient: rank=2, k=3

reproduction_steps: Fit a deterministic full-rank no-constant design before and after multiplying both regressors by 1e-8.
Compare a condition-number 2.014e7 design with independent numpy.linalg.lstsq and run the rank-deficiency test.
findings.disposition: CLOSED. Column scaling plus NumPy lstsq/SVD remains stable and detected rank deficiency is rejected explicitly.

findings.title: Non-finite inputs and non-finite numerical results are rejected
findings.formula_or_invariant: All estimator inputs and returned core estimates must be finite, or fitting must fail explicitly.
affected_cases: public inputs containing Inf, overflow, or an empty complete-case sample

evidence.infinite_regressor: ValueError: OLS inputs must contain only finite values
evidence.all_missing: ValueError: OLS requires at least one complete observation

reproduction_steps: Fit a four-row sample containing an infinite regressor.
Run all-missing and 1e200-scale probes and inspect explicit errors or finite core outputs.
findings.disposition: CLOSED. Input, intermediate, and output finiteness guards prevent invalid estimates from being returned.

findings.title: Degenerate residual or model degrees of freedom no longer produce false inference
findings.formula_or_invariant: Classical covariance requires N-k>0; coefficient or F inference with zero variance or df_model<=0 is undefined and must not be represented by p=0.

evidence.n_equals_k: ValueError: OLS requires positive residual degrees of freedom: n=2, k=2

reproduction_steps: Fit a full-rank 2x2 no-constant design and confirm the residual-df error.
Run the zero-response and intercept-only tests in tests/test_ols.py.
findings.disposition: CLOSED. Invalid residual degrees of freedom are rejected and undefined tests are represented as NaN, not false zero probabilities.

findings.title: No-constant summary uses uncentered Total degrees of freedom and mean square
findings.formula_or_invariant: With c=0 and TSS=y'y, Total df=N and Total MS=TSS/N.
reproduction_steps: Fit the five-row no-constant summary probe.
findings.disposition: CLOSED. OLSResult retains is_con, computes Total df as N-c, and the frozen formula map now names the passing summary regression.

findings.title: Frozen executable oracle is bound to the current frozen inputs
findings.formula_or_invariant: Passing executable evidence must be bound to the exact frozen manifest, cases, data, and audited commit; the oracle hash guard must not be bypassed.
reproduction_steps: Run the Python normalized-result runner on the frozen dataset.
Invoke the oracle formal entry with the current manifest, cases, data, and actual result; observe exit 0 and PASS.
Repeat with a process-substitution manifest containing one extra blank line; observe exit 1 and frozen hash mismatch.
findings.disposition: CLOSED. The current frozen hashes pass the intact guard, a changed input is rejected, and every formal comparison passes.
